sections.title: Sample space & naive probability
beats: Event = the outcomes you care about.
Naive probability = favorable ÷ total. It only works when every outcome is equally likely.
sections.example: Not every outcome is equally likely: 'will BTC go up tomorrow' isn't 50/50 just because there are two outcomes.

sections.title: Counting
beats: Worked: pick 2 of 5 assets to watch: 5×4/2 = 10 pairs.
sections.example: Number of asset pairs to check for correlation grows fast: 20 assets → 190 pairs.
sections.sayback: Explain why we divide by 2 for pairs.
sections.tieback: Liquid Bot: more setups tested = more chance one looks great by luck. That's overfitting again.
